shadow.$description: Elevation, tinted with navy-900 (#1B3A6B). Shadows show on hover, except on elements that float above the page. Never use a shadow as a focus ring or an error state.

sm.$description: Hover on small text cards. navy-900 at 7%.

md.$description: Hover on text cards; floating banners. navy-900 at 10%.

lg.$description: Hover on image cards. navy-900 at 30%.

overlay.$description: Modals: the one element above everything else. navy-900 at 30%.

duration.$description: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, drop every movement (transforms, slides, fade-in travel, shakes, smooth scrolling, looping animations) and keep colour and opacity changes. An animation that starts on its own stops within 5 seconds (WCAG 2.2.2).

fast.$description: Colour, background and border changes; presses.

base.$description: Hover lifts with shadow, menus, toggles.

slow.$description: Content fading in as it appears.

standard.$description: The one easing for every transition and animation.
